theme_strategy: Dual-Identity App (Organic Light Theme for User Portal, Tactical Dark Theme for Admin SOC)

headings.usage: H1/H2 for Hero and Section headings. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Highly legible geometric sans for form labels, descriptions, and buttons.

headings.usage: Use for metric numbers, alert titles, and grid headers. Uppercase, wide spacing.

body.usage: Dense data readability for tables and logs.

user_portal: Glassmorphism for floating headers (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70, border-white/20).
Neumorphism for AI decision cards with soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]).
Subtle noise/grain overlay for a premium, non-digital feel.
admin_dashboard: Grid Borders: border-collapse layout exposing the grid skeleton (border-border/40).
The Tracing Beam: moving glowing borders on critical active threat panels.
Terminal Scanlines: overlay for the live attack feed.

layouts.user_portal: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-16). Mobile-first, single-column stepper flows for KYC. Optical alignment.
layouts.admin_dashboard: The Bento Grid Protocol (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-4. 100% space utilized, sharp edges, no rounded corners greater than sm.

motion.user_portal: Framer Motion for soft organic entrances (y: 20, opacity: 0). Smooth crossfades for bank linking.
motion.admin_dashboard: Micro-interactions, sharp blinks, and pulse effects for live attacks. Typewriter effect for incoming terminal logs.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text.
accessibility.interactive_states: Hover states must explicitly change background and text colors. Focus rings must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.image_strategy: User portal uses warm, natural photography for trust. Admin portal relies solely on UI elements, charts, and technical backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for SOC Dashboard analytics (attack types over time). React Spring Parallax for User Portal landing page storytelling if needed.

image_urls.description: Modern glass bank architecture for the background of the bank integration screen.
Person using a mobile phone, emphasizing a seamless mobile-first onboarding.
Server/Data abstraction to be used as a low-opacity background or hero image for admin login.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx, NOT TypeScript. Do not generate .tsx files. Strip types from Shadcn components if installing manually.
Create two entirely separate visual contexts (e.g. wrapping themes) for User Portal (Organic & Earthy) and Admin SOC Dashboard (Tactical/Dark).
For User Portal, focus on an intent-based, progressive data input flow for KYC and Loan Application. Make it feel highly trustworthy.

For Admin SOC Dashboard, build a command-center interface. Integrate Recharts for attack stats. Include a Security Demo panel that triggers realistic mock attacks (SQLi, Brute Force, etc.) updating the live feed.
Mock all backend integration realistically (Bank connection consent, AI scoring delays).
Never use Space Grotesk or default Vercel-look. Enforce the chosen typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target explicit properties.
Do not center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Never use generic AI emojis. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds over images/content. Always use solid or blurred backdrops.
Ensure layered depth with proper z-index and shadow combinations.
Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create crisp, opinionated designs based on the provided archetypes.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Maintain a clear visual hierarchy using size, weight, and distinct colors.
Incorporate meaningful micro-animations for all user interactions.
Ensure accessible color contrast for all text elements (APCA/WCAG standards).
